title: Taken-over rows keep showing the reminder promise until the one-shot refetch lands — and indefinitely if it fails
detail: The gate reads the model's taken_over_at, which the takeover success handler never updates locally — only the one-shot refetch converges it. Until it lands (or forever if the refetch fails), the panel renders the reminder promise for a row the sweep has already excluded.
recommended_fix: On RefcheckConfirmTakeOver success, update the row's taken_over_at in the model (or apply the response payload) before firing the refetch, so the hint and takeover surface flip together.
